name: tovu
description: Tovu — the website product: CMS runtime (public site + per-site admin + content model).

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node development/scripts/emit-dist-package-json.mjs && mkdir -p dist/src/templates && cp -R src/templates/. dist/src/templates/ && mkdir -p dist/src/themes && cp -R src/themes/. dist/src/themes/ && mkdir -p dist/src/db/drizzle && cp -R src/db/drizzle/. dist/src/db/drizzle/ && mkdir -p dist/src/db/drizzle-database-journal && cp -R src/db/drizzle-database-journal/. dist/src/db/drizzle-database-journal/ && mkdir -p dist/src/public && cp -R src/public/. dist/src/public/
scripts.test:ci: mkdir -p development/coverage && rm -f development/coverage/test-results-all.tap && TSX_TSCONFIG_PATH=apps/site-chat/tsconfig.json node --import tsx --test --experimental-test-module-mocks ${TEST_CONCURRENCY:+--test-concurrency=$TEST_CONCURRENCY} --test-reporter=tap --test-reporter-destination=development/coverage/test-results-all.tap --test-reporter=dot --test-reporter-destination=stdout "src/**/*.test.ts" "packages/*/src/**/*.test.ts" "apps/site-chat/src/**/*.test.ts"
scripts.test:cov: rm -rf development/coverage && mkdir -p development/coverage && TSX_TSCONFIG_PATH=apps/site-chat/tsconfig.json node --import tsx --test --experimental-test-module-mocks ${TEST_CONCURRENCY:+--test-concurrency=$TEST_CONCURRENCY} --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-exclude="**/__no_route_coverage_gate_exclusions__/**" --test-reporter=lcov --test-reporter-destination=development/coverage/lcov.info --test-reporter=spec --test-reporter-destination=stdout "src/**/*.test.ts" "packages/*/src/**/*.test.ts" "apps/site-chat/src/**/*.test.ts"
scripts.test:cov:server: rm -rf development/coverage && mkdir -p development/coverage && node --import tsx --test --experimental-test-module-mocks ${TEST_CONCURRENCY:+--test-concurrency=$TEST_CONCURRENCY} --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-exclude="**/__no_route_coverage_gate_exclusions__/**" --test-reporter=lcov --test-reporter-destination=development/coverage/lcov.info --test-reporter=tap --test-reporter-destination=development/coverage/test-results.tap --test-reporter=dot --test-reporter-destination=stdout "src/server/**/*.test.ts"
scripts.test:cov:server:unit: mkdir -p development/coverage && rm -f development/coverage/lcov.unit.info && node --import tsx --test --experimental-test-module-mocks ${TEST_CONCURRENCY:+--test-concurrency=$TEST_CONCURRENCY} --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-exclude="**/__no_route_coverage_gate_exclusions__/**" --test-reporter=lcov --test-reporter-destination=development/coverage/lcov.unit.info --test-reporter=dot --test-reporter-destination=stdout $(npx tsx development/scripts/list-server-test-files.ts unit)
scripts.test:cov:server:integration: mkdir -p development/coverage && rm -f development/coverage/lcov.integration.info && node --import tsx --test --experimental-test-module-mocks ${TEST_CONCURRENCY:+--test-concurrency=$TEST_CONCURRENCY} --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-exclude="**/__no_route_coverage_gate_exclusions__/**" --test-reporter=lcov --test-reporter-destination=development/coverage/lcov.integration.info --test-reporter=dot --test-reporter-destination=stdout $(npx tsx development/scripts/list-server-test-files.ts integration)
scripts.test:cov:server:tiered: npm run test:cov:server:unit && npm run test:cov:server:integration
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run admin:install && npm run admin:build
